OOS: 2026-01-01 to 2026-08-31; API same exact text rule, frozen before first financing OOS outcome; dates previously researched for other categories so not pristine sealed data
capacity: one covered contract =100 shares; diagnostic maximum contracts=floor(1% min(entry volume,exit volume))
classification: same-filing debt/underwriting excerpts only; no JEV score or label; eligible means text-confirmed completed conventional debt, not verified refinancing or low leverage
construction: starter expiry/strike algorithms on entry-day chain and observed entry stock price; buy 100 shares, sell one 5% OTM standard call
control_sensitivity: same cleaner-entry rule as prior experiment but financing dates replace leadership exclusions
decision: supported only positive primary CI in both historical windows, >=40 primary usable IS events, survives drop-best-three; contradicted only negative CI in both; otherwise inconclusive
dedup: combine both tags by ticker/accession; first event within seven calendar days per company
entry: first session close strictly after filing_date; next-close delay sensitivity
exclude_regex: convertible|exchangeable|common stock|preferred stock|equity units|corporate units|remarketable|acquisition|merger|spin.off|separation|asset.backed|mortgage.backed|structured|linked|contingent|exchange offers|consent solicitation|bankrupt|default|distress
hypothesis: Completed conventional debt issuances generate higher mean covered-call incremental net value over stock alone than equivalent ordinary-day overlays at 21 sessions; financing completion creates insufficient subsequent upside relative to call prices.
matching: same company/year/quarter/weekday, within 63 sessions, identical strike rule, same expiry bucket, DTE difference <=7 days; first three usable by date distance; minimum one
ordinary: no tagged disclosure within 30 calendar days (unchanged prior test)
research_history: one primary financing hypothesis; prior leadership results and 24 team comparisons acknowledged; no strategy/strike/horizon winner selection
robustness: drop three largest positive event-control differences; leave each company out; retain original sign rather than select a better specification
sealed_prediction: fragile: routine debt may already be priced; debt supply may coincide with earnings and macro shocks; no positive replication presumed
uncertainty: frozen connected-company/overlap cluster bootstrap; company-only diagnostic; no reliable primary CI below five components
